requirement: When battery SOC falls below 10% while the vehicle is in Drive, the system shall display a low-battery warning.
generated_given: The vehicle is in Drive and the battery SOC is at or above 10%.
generated_then: The system displays a low-battery warning.

requirement: When a charging request is received and the connector is locked successfully, the system shall enable charging.
If battery voltage is below 300 V for at least 500 ms while the high-voltage system is active, the system shall set a low-voltage diagnostic fault.
generated_given: The high-voltage system is active, and the low-voltage diagnostic fault is not set.
generated_when: The battery voltage remains strictly below 300 V continuously for at least 500 ms.
generated_then: The system sets the low-voltage diagnostic fault.

requirement: If any prerequisite for high-voltage contactor enablement becomes invalid before contactor closure is confirmed, the system shall abort the contactor closing sequence.
generated_given: The high-voltage contactor closing sequence is in progress, all enablement prerequisites are valid, and contactor closure has not been confirmed.
generated_when: Any prerequisite for high-voltage contactor enablement becomes invalid.
generated_then: The system aborts the contactor closing sequence.
